_doc: Single source of truth for LIVE slice candidates only (status in {candidate, reserved, spiking, active, blocked, deferred, validated}). Replaces v1's scattered sources: diagnose-out/backlog.md, risk-register.md-as-candidate-source, and slice-queue.md's candidate section. Lives at <vault>/candidates.json. When a candidate SHIPS (or is rejected) it is MOVED out to <vault>/archive/candidates.json (mirrors slices/ vs slices/archive/) via the vault_edit seam-routed move, keeping the live file small. Written by /diagnose->/slice-candidates, /discover, /reflect, /risk-spike, /validate-slice (append via the vault_edit-append safe channel); /reflect marks the candidate `validated` (code not yet committed) and /commit-slice performs the `validated`->`shipped` move-to-archive once the code lands. Read by /slice (picks the next cut) and /pulse (surfaces the backlog).

_fields.source[].type: OPEN SET (artifact_lint exemption). The buckets the census classifies it into are named constants in scripts/lib/product_scope.py: PRODUCT (`product-scope`, which SUPERSEDES the never-emitted `concept-scope` -- slice-068 / [[ADR-067]]) | HUMAN (user-directed, user-request, user-idea, analysis) | EXHAUST (risk, reality-surprise, reflection*, *-finding, ...). A value in NONE of them lands in the census's `unclassified` bucket, which LISTS it -- an unknown type is LOUD, never silently absorbed. `product-scope` rows are emitted ONLY by product_scope.py and their `ref` is an allocator-minted PS-NNN: that provenance IS the materializer's idempotency key, so it must survive the ship->archive move.
_fields.status: lifecycle: candidate | reserved | spiking | active | blocked | deferred | validated  (LIVE file; reserved = /slice --reserve soft HOLD on pick -- claimed-in-intent, NO slice number minted yet [ADR-016]; validated = /reflect complete, code NOT yet committed)  ->  shipped | rejected  (MOVED to <vault>/archive/candidates.json by /commit-slice once the code lands)
_fields.progress: slice-loop stage of an active candidate: not-started | reserved | spike | design | critique | build | code-review | validate | reflect | complete  (reserved = the pre-spike soft HOLD set by /slice --reserve, before slice-NNN is minted)
_fields.claimed_by: git identity that picked the candidate via /slice: {git_user, git_email}; null until claimed
_fields.started_at: timestamp the slice started (set when /slice claims the candidate); null until claimed
_fields.assumptions[].spike_status: unproven | proving | proven | failed  (the BINARY gate -- `conditional` is deliberately NOT a value here; blocking failed => slice halts at the /risk-spike step-0 gate until fallback is re-spiked)
_fields.assumptions[].spike_verdict: null | go | no-go | conditional  (the spike's TERNARY verdict, set by risk-spike's terminal write alongside spike_status; absent/null on legacy records = unknown -- never default-filled; ADR-002)
_fields.assumptions[].spike_constraints: string[] -- the CONDITIONAL verdict's named constraints the design must respect; REQUIRED non-empty when spike_verdict=conditional; RE-SET to [] on every non-conditional terminal write (vault_edit --set cannot delete keys); artifact_lint flags a non-conditional verdict carrying non-empty constraints as a stale leak
_fields.area: slice-098 / SC-212 ([[ADR-124]] + [[ADR-125]]): OPTIONAL free-text product AREA the candidate asserts FOR ITSELF. Absent/null is the legal norm and the state of every un-annotated candidate -- there is no migration and no retro-tagging. PRECEDENCE: an own valid `area` BEATS the value derived by joining through owner_refs (`product-scope` source -> item.area), including over the multi-parent ambiguity fallback; with no own area today's derived rule is byte-unchanged (exactly one parent carrying an area resolves to it; 0 or 2+ parents -> the reserved `unassigned`). Resolved in exactly ONE place, scripts/lib/area_resolve.py, which both /slice lens paths call. VALIDATED at the write seam by product_scope._valid_area (the SAME recognizer product-scope items use -- never re-implemented): empty / whitespace-only / non-string / the reserved `unassigned` sentinel are REFUSED at rc=2 with candidates.json byte-identical. The SANCTIONED annotation seam is `vault_edit update --file candidates.json --array candidates --id SC-NNN --set area=NAME --append history '{"event":"area-set",...}'` (ADR-125 section 2; the typed producer verb was dropped from that cut) -- the `area-set` history event is CONVENTIONAL, not enforced. `--set area=null` is the sanctioned UN-annotate seam and leaves the key PRESENT with value null. `vault_edit rewrite` is a NAMED-OPEN leg (SC-168) that bypasses the guard, so the read side is TOTAL: an invalid stored area degrades to absent rather than surfacing or crashing. Consumed ONLY by the /slice pick lens (`candidates_top --area`); the capability-progress rollup NEVER reads it -- a candidate is not a capability (AC3, guarded by tests/test_cand_area_1.py). A candidate carries `area`, NEVER `component` (the slice-084 back-compat alias is for product-scope ITEMS only; a supplied `component` is refused outright).
_fields.ejected_from: slice-072 (ADR-077): OWNING slice a residue-born candidate was ejected/captured FROM (slice-NNN). Present ONLY on residue-born candidates (reflect record-on-capture of a Deferred/Discovered item; build-slice mint-split). NORMAL candidates OMIT this key entirely (never null). Sibling of ejection_reason -- built by scripts/lib/residue_disposition.py.
_fields.ejection_reason: slice-072 (ADR-077): the RECORDED, non-empty reason the residue left its owning slice (the legitimate case being an ENVIRONMENT-forced cut no slice budget could absorb). Fail-closed: residue_disposition.py refuses to build a reason-less capture. artifact_lint runs a presence-SYMMETRIC per-row co-constraint keyed on VALUE truthiness -- `ejected_from` truthy <=> `ejection_reason` non-empty; normal rows omit BOTH keys.
_fields.demoted_at: slice-077 ([[ADR-088]]): ISO timestamp a candidate was explicitly DEMOTED ('good enough for now') -- the presence of this sibling pair is what makes a candidate OFF-PATH, lowering its backlog rank by a bounded score-space term (-4) at the candidates_top pick surface WITHOUT deleting its append-only risk-register entry. Present ONLY on a demoted candidate; normal rows OMIT both keys (never null). Written by demote_candidate.py via the SVW-1 seam. off-path DERIVES from these fields' presence -- there is NO stored path_class enum (mirrors ejected_from/ejection_reason and slice-004 'sibling field, not enum extension').
_fields.demote_reason: slice-077 ([[ADR-088]]): the RECORDED, non-empty 'good enough for now' rationale. Fail-closed: demote_candidate.py refuses a reason-less demote, and the eligibility guard refuses a product-scope-sourced (on-path) OR critical/security target so a critical bug is structurally non-demotable. artifact_lint runs the SECOND presence-SYMMETRIC per-row co-constraint (registered ALONGSIDE ejected_from/ejection_reason, list-of-tuples so neither clobbers the other): `demoted_at` truthy <=> `demote_reason` non-empty; normal rows omit BOTH keys.

candidates.title: stripe-webhook-receiver
candidates.description: Receive and verify Stripe webhook events end-to-end; persist to the events table.
candidates.rationale: Retires R-13 (the riskiest external dependency) and ships a user-visible 'payment confirmed' state. <20% of final scope.
candidates.user_visible_outcome: A real test payment flips an order to PAID within the dashboard.

assumptions.statement: Stripe webhook signatures verify with our key rotation scheme and arrive <2s p95 under expected load.

candidates.verification_plan: Real Stripe test-mode event -> verified signature -> row in events table -> order PAID.

candidates.title: realtime-presence
candidates.description: Show which teammates are viewing a doc in real time.
candidates.rationale: User-requested; depends on a push transport we have not proven.
candidates.user_visible_outcome: Avatars of active viewers appear live on the doc.

assumptions.statement: Our managed host's WebSocket support holds 500 concurrent connections per instance without dropping.
assumptions.spike_evidence: Host capped at ~120 concurrent WS before 503s; see spike output.
assumptions.fallback: Switch transport to SSE + short-poll fallback, OR move presence to a managed pub/sub (Ably/Pusher). Re-spike before unblocking.

assumptions.statement: SSE fan-out from one instance covers the presence room sizes we actually see.
spike_constraints: holds to ~120 concurrent connections per instance; shard rooms or move to managed pub/sub above that
assumptions.spike_evidence: Ramped synthetic SSE clients; stable to ~120, degraded beyond.

candidates.verification_plan: Load-test the chosen transport at 500 concurrent before any design work resumes.

candidates.title: purge-dead-auth-shim
candidates.description: Remove the unreachable legacy auth shim flagged as dead code.
candidates.rationale: Owner confirmed dead in diagnosis; no behaviour change, low risk.
candidates.user_visible_outcome: No user-visible change; smaller surface, fewer auth code paths.
candidates.verification_plan: Full test suite green + grep confirms zero references to the shim.

candidates.title: extract-shared-retry-helper
candidates.description: Pull the duplicated retry backoff into a shared helper.
candidates.rationale: Deferred out of slice-072 as an out-of-scope cut; recorded on capture so the cut is not forgotten.
candidates.user_visible_outcome: No user-visible change; one shared retry path instead of duplicated backoff logic.
candidates.ejection_reason: Out of budget for slice-072; a deliberate out-of-scope cut recorded on capture (residue provenance, ADR-077).
candidates.verification_plan: Full test suite green + both call sites use the shared helper.

candidates.title: verbose-cli-help-text-cleanup
candidates.description: Trim the over-long --help epilogue on the export command.
candidates.rationale: A genuinely low-value off-path polish item; DEMOTED so it stops sitting above real work in the backlog without being deleted (slice-077 / ADR-088).
candidates.user_visible_outcome: Shorter, clearer --help output; no behaviour change.
candidates.demote_reason: Good enough for now: cosmetic help-text polish, deliberately parked below active work (off-path, ADR-088). Its risk-register entry is untouched.
candidates.verification_plan: Full test suite green + --help renders the trimmed epilogue.
